name: Philip Kenny
title: General Counsel and Company Secretary
bio:
General Counsel and Company Secretary with 18+ years’ post-qualification experience advising FTSE-listed, regulated and private groups and companies across complex, high-value transactions, regulatory investigations and corporate governance reform, with a proven track record acting at C-suite and board level to lead legal, compliance, data protection and secretariat functions through BAU, transformation, M&A and remediation programmes — including successful take-private deals, forensic investigations and board restructuring. 

I bring deep expertise in corporate governance, FCA regulation, corporate finance and capital markets, all forms of commercial contracting, IP, data protection, litigation oversight, risk management and cross-border matters. 

I have built and led high-performing legal and secretariat teams, embedded enterprise-wide controls, driven cultural reform and delivered strategic counsel at main board and executive committee levels, producing materially protective and value-creating legal outcomes. 

Recognised by Legal 500 for in-house legal excellence, team building, controls and cultural reform, I have acted as a trusted advisor to Chairs, CEOs, CFOs and NEDs to help shape resilient, compliant and commercially agile organisations.

name: Alison Forestell
title: Passionate about people and ensuring the health of our communities.
bio: Through the power of leadership, connection, and collaborative partnerships, Alison develops and implements strategies that advance the health and well-being of people and communities. Grounded in a strong commitment to social accountability, health equity, and meaningful impact, she works to align organizational priorities to support community needs and sustainable outcomes. Alison’s passion for helping others began early in her career as the owner of a successful direct marketing agency, where she helped local and national organizations raise funds and raise their profile. This meaningful work exposed her to the vibrant and essential work of Canada’s charitable sector, as well as organizations that put purpose into practice to support some of Canada’s most vulnerable communities. Alison believes healthy societies are more stable, equitable, and resilient — and that investing in health is one of the most important ways to build a stronger future for everyone.

bio: I lead the Indigenous Women and Youth Programs at NACCA, where I've spearheaded transformative initiatives. Through strategic fundraising efforts, I secured $30 million for the national Indigenous Women Entrepreneurship (IWE) Program, facilitating over $6 million in micro-loans to Indigenous women-owned businesses nationwide. Additionally, I supported the establishment of the Indigenous Business Hub in Ottawa, now a thriving community hub serving over 270 members. I am deeply committed to Indigenous advocacy, regularly engaging in public speaking and supporting organizations in an advisory capacity, to amplify the importance of Indigenous economic development and reconciliation in Canada. I am from Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory and a proud member of the Mohawks of the Bay of Quinte.

title: Head of Sales and Strategic Partnerships at Food Forest Abundance.  We are building a localized decentralized food supply and keeping it extremely simple by working with permanent agriculture. Food forests everywhere!
bio: Driven by a lifelong passion for innovation, connection, and nature, Matthew Britt brings over two decades of entrepreneurial experience to his role The Commonstead—a company redefining how we live, build, and thrive through sustainable, self-sufficient living technologies.At The Commonstead, Matthew is the Chief Execution Officer for the Food Biome and he also leads strategy and partnerships that empower homeowners, companies, builders, and communities to integrate smart, regenerative systems for food, water, energy, and wellness. The Commonstead is dedicated to accelerating the global shift toward resilient, abundant living by showcasing the world’s best innovations in sustainability through education, technology, and demonstration.A former national champion hockey player turned entrepreneur, Matthew has built and scaled multiple ventures with a mission-driven focus. He is a part owner of Food Forest Abundance, a global movement designing and installing permaculture food systems that decentralize food and medicine production. He is also a founding partner of Unitree, a blockchain company aligning human energy with nature’s regenerative power through land-backed digital assets.Matthew is deeply committed to helping people reconnect with nature and reclaim self-reliance—blending advanced technology with timeless natural principles to create true abundance. He is also the cohost of Seeds of Abundance, a show that spotlights visionary leaders and entrepreneurs providing real-world solutions to the world’s greatest challenges.🌿 Learn more about Matthew’s projects:https://thecommonstead.comwww.foodforestabundance.comhttps://unitree.earthLet’s connect and build the future of abundance together.

title: Digital Marketing Manager | AI Enthusiast | SEO & Social Media Strategist | Empowering Businesses with Innovative Solutions & Growth Strategies
bio:
I am a Digital Marketing Manager with hands-on experience leading growth and performance marketing across paid media, SEO strategy, social media, and analytics for service-based and eCommerce businesses.

My strength lies in owning digital marketing outcomes end-to-end from strategy and execution planning to performance analysis, reporting, client communication, and team coordination. I have worked with global clients and cross-functional teams, ensuring clarity, accountability, and consistent results across channels.

Core areas of expertise:

- Paid Media: Meta Ads & Google Ads (lead generation and growth-focused campaigns)
- SEO Strategy: keyword planning, content direction, on-page optimization oversight
- Social Media Marketing (SMM): campaign planning, messaging alignment, performance tracking
- Analytics & Reporting: GA4, dashboards, insights, and optimization roadmaps
- AI-Driven Marketing: practical use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) to improve efficiency, content workflows, and decision-making

In my current role, I collaborate closely with internal teams (PPC, SEO, creative, content) and stakeholders to deliver scalable digital marketing solutions aligned with business goals. I focus on results, structure, and sustainable growth, not just execution.

I am currently open to:

- Digital Marketing Manager / Growth Marketing roles (India or Remote)
- Opportunities with global companies or agencies
- Training / teaching engagements in practical digital marketing

If you’re looking for someone who can lead digital growth, manage clients and teams, and drive measurable performance, feel free to connect.

bio: I build search strategies that drive revenue, not just rankings. Over 8+ years, I've led organic growth across three countries and multiple industries — founding and scaling SEO functions from zero, managing six-figure budgets, and delivering multi-million-pound ROI for a £50M+ property portfolio. I translate technical strategy into measurable business outcomes at every level of an organization. What I bring to the table: - Revenue-first leadership: Built marketing departments from scratch with 90%+ organic traffic growth and 40%+ margins. Expanded single-channel SEO programs into integrated growth strategies spanning content, CRO, SEM, and paid media. - Cross-functional execution: Led enterprise migrations, high-volume content operations (500+ assets/year), full website rebrands, and award-winning campaigns recognized by the Global Search Awards and UK Digital Growth Awards. - Systems thinking: Great strategy outlasts the strategist. I build scalable frameworks, mentor specialists, and create infrastructure that compounds over time. At Compose.ly, I lead Client Services for 60+ accounts and am actively shaping how we integrate AI-influenced search (GEO/AEO) into programs that still prioritize what actually works: content built for humans, structured for algorithms. Outside of that, I run YourSEORoadmap.com — a productized consulting practice where I've delivered 200+ execution-ready audits to in-house teams and growth-stage companies who need senior-level strategy without the agency retainer. Clients have used these roadmaps to close six-figure agency contracts and start seeing organic traction within 90 days. I build omnichannel revenue engines for DTC and high-growth brands; the kind that turn ad spend into attribution, brand chaos into positioning, and email lists into recurring revenue. With an MS in Marketing (University of Tampa) and 10+ years leading strategy across e-commerce, financial services, and consumer products, I've operated as both an embedded marketing director and an independent consultant. That means I move fast, earn trust without org-chart authority, and translate aggressive growth goals into campaigns that deliver real numbers. What I actually do: → Architect full-funnel strategies across paid media, SEO, email automation, content, and CRO - from zero or from broken → Integrate AI and automation into marketing operations as a genuine force multiplier, not a talking point → Serve as the senior marketing voice in the room; C-suite translator, agency manager, team builder → Own revenue metrics, not vanity metrics What I've delivered: → $370K in marketing-attributed revenue + 43% subscription growth at a DTC skincare brand through brand repositioning, SEO, and email strategy → 180% email campaign revenue growth via segmentation, lifecycle automation, and deliverability overhaul → 80% sales growth for an international e-commerce brand through targeted seasonal campaign architecture → 28% overall revenue increase ($373K) with 43% of sales directly attributed to marketing Recognized as Top 1% Expert-Vetted on Upwork | 100% Job Success Score | 55+ engagements completed My edge: Most CMOs are either creative or analytical. I'm both, and I've built teams that are too. My foundation is a Bachelors of Accounting (Stellenbosch University), which means I don't just speak marketing — I speak CFO. P&L accountability, LTV:CAC ratios, payback periods, pipeline economics — I understand what the numbers mean to the rest of the business, not just the marketing dashboard. I've led cross-functional campaigns without direct authority and consistently produced results that outran the budget. Open to: ✦ Fractional CMO engagements (retainer or project-based) ✦ Marketing Director / VP Marketing (full-time, in-house) ✦ Senior consulting partnerships 📩 lombardcc26@gmail.com

bio: Hi, I’m Ilona!✨ 💁🏼‍♀️Welcome to my LinkedIn page — I’m a digital marketing specialist with 8+ years of experience. From PPC and SEO to social media and content marketing, I focus on building multi-channel campaigns that engage the right audience and drive real results. 👉🏻Here’s what I do best:  1. Advanced Targeting: I know how to find the people most likely to become your customers, so you don’t waste your budget.  2. Multi-Channel Planning: I’ve spent the last five years creating cohesive marketing plans that align PPC, SEO, social media, and more under one clear strategy.  3. Maximizing Conversions & ROI: I do detailed testing, before scaling campaigns, so no budget is wasted. By analyzing data, I optimize ads and track returns continuously.  4. KPIs Tracking and Budget Management: I have a proven method for setting and measuring goals, so we know exactly where to invest for the best results. 5. Adapt to Change: I stay on top of trends and keep marketing strategies fresh so you stay competitive.   👉🏻My Management Experience: I’ve successfully managed marketing teams and led diverse projects to ensure our marketing strategies are executed effectively from start to finish. By setting clear objectives, delegating tasks, and monitoring performance, I help teams stay aligned and deliver on time. 👉🏻My Key Specializations:  - Marketing Consulting  - PPC and Paid Search  - SEO (Search Engine Optimization)  - Content Marketing  - Social Media Marketing (SMM)  - Video Marketing  - Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO)   💡If you need a results-focused digital marketer who can lead teams, handle today’s digital marketing challenges and drive real growth, let’s connect and make it happen!

name: Burak Senguloglu
title: Head of Digital at Link Dijital | Digital Marketing Director E‑Commerce
bio: As a seasoned Digital Marketing Director with over 11 years of experience and currently Head of Digital at Link Dijital, I blend engineering-honed analytical rigor with creative vision to architect data-driven campaigns, drive business development, and lead high-performance teams toward transformative digital solutions. My journey began in primary school, where a fascination with the power of the internet led me to build my first HTML pages. Today, I channel that same curiosity into AI-driven tools and PHP development, harnessing automation and intelligent systems to streamline workflows and elevate targeting precision. I design and implement end-to-end e-commerce strategies for leading platforms such as IKAS, OpenCart, Ticimax, and Shopify, as well as marketplaces like Trendyol, Hepsiburada, and Amazon; leveraging complex integrations, custom API implementations, platform-specific advertising solutions, and granular conversion tracking to ensure measurable growth. To complement these strategic initiatives, I apply technical proficiency in PHP development and AI automation as supportive elements—enhancing web infrastructure stability, accelerating deployment cycles, and enabling real-time performance optimization without losing sight of creative vision. As a collaborative leader, I’ve guided cross-functional teams of up to 15 specialists across design, content, development, and media buying—fostering an environment where operational discipline and creative freedom coexist, and clear KPIs translate into sustained business impact. Beyond the office, I’m passionate about exploring new cultures—whether traveling across Türkiye or abroad—and draw creative inspiration from techno music, blogging about digital trends, and hands-on project development. I bring this same energy and dedication to every initiative, committed to driving innovation and excellence in all I do. If you'd like to get to know me, ask questions, or seek assistance on this career journey I've embarked on, feel free to send an email to iletisim@buraksenguloglu.com.

bio:
With over 10 years of experience in digital marketing, I specialize in driving performance and delivering results for high-profile clients across the computer software and eCommerce industries. From crafting data-driven strategies to leading teams and optimizing multi-channel campaigns, I thrive on helping businesses grow and exceed their goals.

I’ve honed my skills across all areas of digital marketing, including paid media, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), and performance analysis, managing everything from Google Ads and Meta campaigns to full-funnel optimizations. My approach blends creativity with analytical precision to deliver impactful outcomes that align with business objectives.

Whether it's collaborating with clients to develop tailored strategies, mentoring teams to foster excellence, or diving deep into data to uncover opportunities, I’m passionate about building scalable solutions that drive growth.

Let’s connect to talk marketing, strategy, or how I can help elevate your brand’s digital presence.

name: Andrew Harding
title: Software Manager
bio:
At Blue Origin, my focus has been on hiring and developing multiple teams of software and hardware engineers focused on avionics, MATLAB, ground software, system engineering, and data analysis. I focused on integrating AI into various aspects of the New Glenn rocket's software and tools infrastructure, including the development process, software architecture, code reviews, and mentoring. We continuously gathered feedback and adjusted according to what we found. Our teams have valued fast feedback, rapid iteration, and teamwork to solve issues. We developed guidelines for evaluating ChatGPT output, common scripts, and standards that we wanted AI to follow. Focused on how to store and optimize the large volumes of data from flights and tests to best support analysis and decision making. We based our teams’ philosophies on a growth mindset, common goals, and the value of the team.
As part of the Reusable Stage Two team on New Glenn, we worked on many different radio solutions to help get the rocket through the blackout phase of re-entry. We studied everything from simple antennas to complex phased arrays. We worked with X, S, Ka, and Ku band solutions. We worked with communication providers that utilize satellites in LEO, MEO, and GEO orbits. 
Previously, as a Software Development Manager at Embark Trucks, I led cross-functional teams in creating robust frameworks for autonomous vehicles. We supported sensor and route planning teams, as well as supported the trucks as they operated. The sensor teams collaborated on a sensor fusion approach that utilized Lidar, Radar, and vision. Our efforts yielded advanced software solutions that supported both research and production, with a focus on over-the-air updates and vehicle interactions. With a commitment to Agile methodologies and a growth mindset, we cultivated an environment of continuous improvement, contributing to the development of self-driving technology.
I have worked with safety-certified software for aerospace, defense, automotive, industrial, and other areas. I prefer working with mixed-criticality systems that have well-defined boundaries and multiple checks to ensure we are safe and operating effectively. I have many years of experience with IoT software and the Big Data issues that arise from large volumes of data flowing in from these installations.
I have over 30 years of experience as a software manager, developer, team lead, systems engineer, technical sales representative, project manager, and program manager.

name: Marc Carmel
title: Legal Practice Management consultant
bio:
Thankyou for taking the time to view my profile. With over 22 years’ experience setting up and managing UK Law firms, I have built a strong reputation as a commercially astute Lawfirm management consultant who is considered a safe pair of hands by all of my clients. I have been with most of them since inception having supported through the initial setup, and continued with ongoing finance and compliance management enabling them to grow safely and with a strong foundation on which to develop the Practice. 

My experience is mainly but not exclusively with SME firms from 1 to 8 Partners in size, with staffing levels between 1 and 50. I have successfully managed the Lawfirm Accounts, Compliance, IT, Procurement, Marketing and HR with most clients depending on the size of the firm, and assistance required. 

I have successfully achieved 5 years spotless Lexcel approval, as well as CQS, Cyber essentials, Legal 500 submissions, and an excellent record with clear SAR audits with all clients. 
Prior to my career in Law I was a senior Procurement manager for over 12 years which gave me strong focus in analysis, negotiation and account management.

Please give me a call on 07921 728 331 or drop me a line on marc@polariscompliance.co.uk for some information and to arrange a visit.

title: Legal sector innovator, strategist, consultant, retained advisor and fractional exec
bio: I’ve probably been at this long enough now to be able to say I’m a serial pioneer of innovative models and business ideas in the legal sector. Author of 'The Agile Law Firm', my 3rd book, published May 2021. My work as a mentor, consultant, retained advisor, speaker and author is focused on how legal and professional organisations achieve fundamental and sustainable change in 4 areas: - Strategy Execution: equip organisations to clearly define and deliver their business strategy for the 2020s - Growth Strategy - Legal Operations: future-proofed operating environments - Business Services Excellence: ensure organisations get the highly integrated and efficient business services they need - Performance Improvement – analyse & identify solutions for improving firm, practice or office financial performance, process & reporting My advice draws on a career working in and with multiple leading businesses at the highest level: • I have worked for all four of the Big 4 professional firms: PWC, EY, as KPMG’s UK Ambassador for Professional Practices & as legal operations architect in Deloitte Legal • In my 12 years on the Board at leading European law firm Osborne Clarke I was Finance Director, COO and Chief Executive through a period of incredible growth (turnover increased 8-fold) & created a unique & innovative law firm model • I was hired by managed service & Alternative Legal Service (ALSP) pioneers Integreon as COO for US and Europe, helping them achieve market leadership - some of my global leadership colleagues went on to found trail-blazing law company Elevate • I returned to consulting with global legal strategy firm Edge International in 2011 and have also been a founder of Kingsmead Square, the Intuity Alliance and Bristol+BathLegalTech • I advised a series of the largest and most high profile businesses to form early Alternative Business Structures (ABS), including KPMG, DAS, LegalZoom and Jordans. • I curate, present at and chair 15-20 legal events each year and am constantly delighted by the amazing feedback from delegates - and by how much speakers and panellists enjoy the experience too! I also deliver Strategy Retreats and Partner Conferences and I regularly curate conference programmes and author Best Practice Guides on legal business topics

I enjoy analysing qualitatively and quantitatively where new ground can be broken, new processes can be introduced and existing things can be done better. I want to find solutions, take action and deliver results which make a real difference.

name: John Ferko
title: Chief Operating Officer at Richards, Layton & Finger
bio: John Ferko is Chief Operating Officer at Richards, Layton & Finger, Delaware's largest corporate law firm. An executive with deep legal industry experience, John previously held roles with three international law firms, serving in chief operating officer, chief financial officer, and practice management roles. He was formerly a certified public accountant at one of the largest accounting firms in the United States, where he worked with clients in a broad range of industries, including financial, real estate/construction, manufacturing/distribution, technology, and professional services. John’s unique, varied and deep experience makes him an ideal strategist for both clients and law firms. John earned a bachelor’s degree in accounting from The Pennsylvania State University and participated in premier executive education programs, including The George Washington University’s masters in Law Firm Management program and the Harvard Law School’s “Leadership in Law Firms” program. John is passionate about delivering value in the client-firm relationship, and frequently speaks at legal industry conferences on the topic of client value, and the related disciplines of pricing, practice management, process improvement and negotiation. This passion also led him to co-found The True Value Partnering Institute, a virtual hub and think tank connecting legal industry thought leaders and those responsible for driving value in their organizations.

bio: Performance-driven professional with extensive experience in leading business development operations obtained within a variety of organisations, including investment banks, wealth managers, start-ups and growth stage companies. Significant experience and an established track record in managing and directing business initiatives in startup and growth companies, implementing cross border compliance frameworks, developing revenue growth strategies, initiating sales and marketing programs, and identifying new revenue opportunities. Recent C-suite experience and responsibilities for strategic business planning, government agency liaison, corporate governance (including compliance and risk management), third party and vendor management as well as negotiation on behalf of a regulated fintech business in the UK and the US. Strengths include a focus on all aspects of compliance, risk and financial management, execution and implementation of operational objectives. Proven success in fostering professional relationships with key stakeholders (internal and external) and clients. Have worked in the UK, Singapore, Hong Kong and the US. My key areas of expertise are:- • Compliance • Risk management • Start-up / Growth experience • Strategic Planning & Implementation • Operational experience – UK / US / Asia • Problem Resolution • Financial Management • Performance Improvement • Business Development • Team Leadership Throughout my career, I have been instrumental at strategic business planning, government agency liaison, and vendor negotiation. Broad based experience in compliance, brand positioning, financial management, and operational excellence.

Recognized for demonstrating a natural aptitude for optimizing systems for financial management and performance, as well as for leading teams in improving compliance and controls. Professional focal points include accounting processes, accounts payable and receivable, reconciliations, budget administration, payroll, financial statements, audit management, client consultation, relationship management, and team leadership. Delivering superior administration on the latter areas of expertise requires utilization of effective communication and negotiation skills, as well as business acumen, performance analysis, project management, and resource management to support efficiency and maximum returns. Currently, I am the Controller with Basis 365 Accounting. Under my leadership, I direct operations as the Controller for 18 cloud-based accounting departments for small businesses, partnering closely with clients to gather and assess their requirements in order to deliver tailored services for optimal business performance. I also govern an accounting team of 12 in executing all accounting operations while proactively elevating standards of quality and compliance, demonstrating superb team coordination and coaching. In addition, I liaise with senior leadership, stakeholders, and financial management teams to ensure clients’ accounting support structure is driving business forward with minimal expenditures. Colleagues describe me as a progressive, driven, down-to-earth, strategic and managerial financial systems expert who can be relied on to offer superior solutions that deliver profitable results on time and under budget. I am interested in contacting former colleagues and managers, as well as other professionals in my field. Feel free to contact me through this profile if you wish to connect.

bio: I enjoy routines, order, and deadlines that tell me what’s next. So, it’s no surprise I’ve remained an accountant since graduation. Of course, even in accounting, there’s change – companies grow and shrink, COVID happens, and requests come last-minute. Through it all, I’ve maintained a reputation for getting work done on time, accurately, and within the guidelines of established practices. Due to my efficient work habits, managers often task me with completing special accounting projects alongside my regular duties. They also count on me to pay close attention to internal and external deadlines and keep them informed along the way. WHAT MANAGERS SAY “Your ability to please 3 different bosses is a rare talent...your willingness to manage change while having a great attitude has encouraged us and many of the employees.” ➤ Reporting Quarterly and Yearly Progress ➤ Talent for Tracking and Communicating Status Across Multiple Initiatives CAREER HIGHLIGHTS ➤ WORKING THROUGH ACCOUNTING CHANGES I’ve adjusted my daily processes during periods of rapid company growth, slow declines, and through digital transformations and upgrades. No matter what comes, I make things work so accounting data can be retrieved and put in the hands of the people who need it. ➤ CLEANING UP RECORDS At the regional office of a major travel company, I reduced by 50% a backlog of unpaid traffic tickets mistakenly assessed to company by developing a detailed process for disputing, tracking, and closing these billing errors. Through persistence, planning, and careful documentation, I recovered $100K of outstanding receivables that were >2 years old. A literal clean up! I organized 100s of water-drenched boxes of records into secure storage and created a catalog system for on-demand retrieval.

name: Cara Antoine
title: Executive Vice President | Chief Technology, Innovation & Portfolio Officer | Non-Exec Board Director | Keynote Speaker | Active at intersection of Innovation & Humanity | European Women on Boards | Women in Tech®
bio: I am an Executive Vice President and Chief Technology, AI & Innovation Officer with over 30 years of executive leadership in AI strategy, digital transformation, enterprise technology, and innovation management across EMEA and Northern and Central Europe. As EVP and Chief Technology, AI and Innovation Officer at Capgemini, I lead AI-powered enterprise transformation, portfolio strategy, business innovation, and corporate strategy across 34,000 employees, partnering with C-suite executives and boards on AI ecosystems, cloud strategy, data platforms, IoT, OT, cybersecurity, and sovereign technology programmes. I design cross-industry Centres of Excellence and deliver differentiated portfolio offers across energy, life sciences, automotive, retail, public sector, and manufacturing. As Chief Marketing Officer and Chief Operations Officer at Microsoft Netherlands, I led P&L accountability, go-to-market strategy, and digital transformation across a multi-billion-dollar technology operation. As Vice President and Chief Information Officer at Shell, I drove digital transformation, process excellence, and IT capability development across global downstream and upstream oil and gas operations through IoT, Lean, operational rigour, and operational transformation, delivering over $960M in commercial value. As Managing Director at IG&H, I led digital transformation and ESG strategy across healthcare, MedTech, energy transition, and utilities. I serve as Non-Executive Director and Board Advisor across deep technology, digital health, and MedTech ecosystems in the Netherlands, Benelux, and Europe, contributing AI strategy, innovation governance, and responsible technology expertise. I am founding President and Chairwoman of Women in Tech Netherlands, advisory board member for the European Society of Cataract and Refractive Surgeons, and Non-Executive Director at the Cornea Patients Association. I am a 3x bestselling author and international keynote speaker on AI, digital transformation, innovation leadership, and inclusion. My academic foundation includes a Doctorate in Business Administration and IMD executive certifications in High Performance Leadership and Sustainability. I received my Board certification and accreditation at Harvard University. I turn complexity into clarity, equipping organisations with AI maturity, digital transformation capability, business innovation leadership, and corporate strategy confidence to unlock enduring value.

bio: Digital Transformation Thought-Leader in real world | Marketing Innovation, Business Technologies, Digital Media Comms and Fintech-Insurtech-Neobanks Technologist. Innovation manager & omnichannel marketing leader (CMO) con 20 anni di esperienza in ruoli direzionali ricoperti in aziende italiane, startup e gruppi multinazionali in mercati fortemente innovativi, ad alto tasso di crescita e valore aggiunto. Nei settori banca e finanza, automotive, energia, ICT e PA digitale (HP, BNP Paribas, Saint Gobain, EU Commission, Unioncamere) mi sono occupato di trasformazione digitale, marketing innovation, branding e comunicazione multicanale, di relazioni istituzionali e di rapporti con gli stakeholder, di creazione e gestione reti e di sviluppo del capitale umano attraverso il trasferimento di conoscenza e di cultura digitale acquisita sul campo. Oggi ricopro il ruolo di innovation manager & team digital coordinator nel sistema camerale per l’adozione delle tecnologie digitali ed emergenti nelle aziende secondo il piano nazionale “Transizione 4.0” e coordino l'accordo “eBay per le PMI” e la formazione “Google University - Eccellenze in Digitale”. In sinergia con le Istituzioni, utilizzo le risorse a disposizione per finanziare marketplace digitali (e-commerce), per individuare capitali di rischio di investitori specializzati in private equity e venture capital e per far accedere le PMI ai nuovi strumenti di finanza alternativa digitale come crowdfunding, invoice financing e minibond. Giornalista OdG Lombardia, pubblico articoli scientifici, scrivo per testate nazionali ed estere di economia, marketing, tecnologia, innovazione ed intervengo come relatore, moderatore, speaker e brand voicer (tra cui BNP Paribas, SwissCognitive e Paris Fintech Forum) a convegni e a forum pubblici. Sono inserito da diverse organizzazioni indipendenti internazionali tra le persone più influenti a livello globale nell’indirizzare i processi di Digital Transformation e Marketing Innovation delle imprese, in particolare nei settori banca e finanza (FinTech), industria (AI e IoT), Academics & Researchers (EdTech) ed Istituzionale (GovTech). In ambito accademico, sono docente in economia, marketing dell’innovazione, comunicazione digitale d’impresa e beni culturali (Università di Pavia, Università Statale di Milano, Gruppo e-Campus). A livello istituzionale, partecipo come esperto a Commissioni e Comitati Strategici ad indirizzo governativo (situation & decision room) e dal 2013 sono advisor esterno (data business analyst) e valutatore di progetti controllati da Commissione europea.

bio: Chief Innovation Officer | Business & Technology Executive Director @ GFT Technologies ItaliaI help organizations turn AI, data and digital technologies into measurable business value by connecting strategy, innovation and execution.At GFT Technologies Italia, I am responsible for cross-market Centres of Excellence and Business Units focused on Agentic AI, Data & AI, Customer Experience, Customer Engagement Platforms, Cloud, legacy systems modernization and AI-powered Knowledge Management.My role is to shape, industrialize and scale innovation-led solutions, aligning market needs, technology capabilities and go-to-market execution. Through the Centres of Excellence, Business Units and Innovation Team, I focus on building value-driven offerings, accelerating customer innovation and developing AI-based products that support enterprise transformation at scale.With 25+ years of experience in strategic technology leadership, consulting and healthcare innovation, I have led complex transformation programs, built high-performance organizations and supported growth across European and international contexts.My experience includes:• Agentic AI, Data & AI and advanced data platforms• Customer Experience and Customer Engagement Platforms• Cloud transformation and legacy systems modernization• Digital and omnichannel transformation• SAP, intelligent process automation and scalable architectures• Innovation governance, R&D and AI-based product development• Tech-driven M&A and post-deal integrationBefore joining GFT Technologies Italia, I served as Chief Technology and Innovation Officer for Capgemini Europe Cluster and previously as Global CIO and CTIO in a Swiss multinational group.I am PMP-certified and have been Lecturer in Digital Transformation for MBA and Executive MBA programs at Bologna Business School.My leadership philosophy is based on visionary pragmatism: imagining bold futures and building them with structure, clarity and execution discipline, while turning innovation into value for businesses, people and a better future.

title: Innovation? Empower your Innovators! | Lean Company Building | Corporate Startup Executive
bio: With +15-year of experience from creating innovation programs at Deutsche Telekom with hundreds of participants & dozens of NewCos, I now help founders build strategic confidence as a mentor. Doing so at Deutsche Telekom and as being self-employed, I support both "gonnabe founders" who happen to still be employed, and founders of startups, to face and solve their strategic challenges themselves. I create a safe space for innovators to open up and reflect on their situation, and help them define their own solution through listening, feedback, and advice. I also facilitate new connections (via my extensive network of innovators from all across Europe). It is my core belief that if you want to innovate, you must support your innovators in the first place. Plus: as innovators are everywhere, we as a society should not overlook any one of them but help them unconditionally. Finally, innovation ecosystems are made by leaders and feeders, where both of which are equally important. In this sense, I like to think of myself as being a leading feeder ;-).

title: Chief Technology and Innovation Manager for Strategic Sustainable Initiatives (DPP, Industry Business Networks, Digital Twins and Data-Interoperability))
bio: Be Agile. Learn constantly. Embrace Technology. Accelerate fast. Put Purpose-Led as a priority. Today's innovation race requires early identification of technology trends. You can call them also horizon 2 and three trends. While understanding the impact and trying to embed those technological capabilities, it can differentiate you from the rest. We are entering a world of disruption, which will have a profound impact in every sector and industry. Current technical capabilities, like the Internet of things (IoT), Machine Learning (ML), Artificial Intelligence (AI), Blockchain (BC), are doubling their capabilities and power in an 'exponential ways.' The intersection between those technical capabilities, those are creating endless possibilities and do impact our world and your businesses. I call this phenomenon 'the perfect turbulence.' So while executing your Digital Transformation Roadmap, this Perfect Turbulence is also traveling with you. Meaning, that while you are transforming, those disruptive tech capabilties and the power are growing exponentially, and impacting you constantly. I'm passioned to help you to understand the intersections of those disruptive technologies, and to explore the possibilities with technical capabilities and new ways to solve difficult challenges. Moreover, while doing this, I urge everybody to mix those innovation journeys with purpose-led-innovations because we are all responsible for making the world more beautiful and for letting it run better. Would you like to know more on how we can help to accelerate your business with new capabilities, or you would like to get support on your purpose-led innovation use-cases, drop me an email or find me via another channel. I'm ready to help! Are you ready to accelerate? Profile: Digital Innovation Expert, Innovation Evangelist, Technology Futurist, Design Thinker, Speaker, Workshop Moderator, Innovation Orchestrator.

name: Timm Schorsch-trautwein
title: Chief Digital Officer HR @Deutsche Bahn AG
bio: Timm Schorsch-Trautwein is a German-American Manager in the area of SCM, mobility, HR and digital transformation. As the Chief Digital Officer of the HR department of Deutsche Bahn AG he drives digitalization in this area through People Analytics and digital innovation approaches. Besides he works as a systemic coach in the startup and social business sector. He was a Research Associate at WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management, Germany and holds doctoral degree in economics in the field of supply chain management. His research interests include behavioral supply chain management, particularly from the social psychological perspective and with a focus on human–machine interactions. Prior to his doctoral studies, he graduated from Linköping University, Sweden and Technische Universtiät Braunschweig, Germany as an Industrial Engineer. He is a frequently invited speaker at both business and research conferences. He has worked on projects in Bulgaria, Germany, Italy, Poland, Romania and the UK.

name: Adam Kahn
title: Communications Director with more than 25 years of strategic leadership expertise
bio: I have overseen the global communications strategy and planning for some of the most iconic and beloved franchises in gaming, such as Star Wars, Tomb Raider and Marvel's Avengers. I have more than 25 years of experience in PR and communications, with extensive contacts in both consumer and gaming media, and cross-functional expertise in numerous areas, such as influencer/content creator management, business development, executive communication, community management, event management, investor relations, and crisis communications. I have a proven track record of launching multi-million selling titles for all platforms, working with both licensed properties and original IP, and collaborating with both internal and external development teams and stakeholders. I have also spearheaded earned influencer/content creator outreach and led corporate and executive PR efforts, counseling senior executives for presentations with investors, conferences, and other events. I have worked with and managed both large internal PR teams and smaller groups with outside agencies, and I have the skills required to empower and support PR professionals and executives. My mission is to deliver impactful and engaging communications that showcase the creativity and passion of developers and their games.

bio: I'm an experienced communications leader with over 13 years of expertise in public relations, communications, and public affairs, both in agency and in-house settings. Adept at spearheading cross-functional communication campaigns across diverse industries, from luxury hospitality groups to Fortune 100 companies. As a passionate storyteller, I approach each opportunity with creativity and strategic acumen, meticulously attending to every detail. My track record showcases proficiency as a poised and confident leader, able to quickly assess complex situations and excel under pressure while managing multiple projects simultaneously. I thrive in fast-paced environments, leveraging my extensive skills in public affairs, public relations, government relations, corporate communications, and strategic partnerships to deliver impactful results. Brand awareness and storytelling are my forte, skillfully navigating media relations and consumer communications to elevate brands' reputations. Additionally, I possess considerable expertise in crisis communications and executive communications, ensuring a proactive and agile approach to managing reputational challenges. My commitment to thought leadership development has been instrumental in driving organizations forward, strategically positioning them as industry leaders and creating lasting impacts. I'm thrilled to have contributed to the success to many brands, and I look forward to new opportunities to apply my expertise, collaborate, and achieve even greater heights.

name: Wendy Spander
title: Global Communications, Logitech
bio: Seasoned product public relations and corporate communications leader with a passion for storytelling and strategy. I bring deep expertise in media relations — including strong media relationships across media channels — as well as internal/corporate communications, C-level messaging, event planning, and social media. My approach is results-driven, collaborative, and focused on elevating brand visibility and reputation, whether for large global organizations or smaller startups. I specialize in: -Building and maintaining strong relationships with media and influencers -Crafting and executing strategic communications plans aligned with business goals -Managing PR teams and agencies, both in-house and globally -Leading internal, executive, and crisis communications -Driving integrated campaigns across social, digital, and traditional platforms -Partnering with marketing, vendors, and agencies globally to amplify brand messaging Areas of expertise include: -Media relations, press materials & media kits -Strategic PR planning and quarterly business reviews -Performance metrics and KPI tracking -C-Level and executive communications -Global budget & team management -Crisis, corporate, and internal communications -Agency RFP and selection - International event planning -Social media, influencer engagement, and partnerships -Tech, sports, entertainment and consumer PR -Trade show strategy and execution Outside of work, I’m a proud Bay Area sports fanatic (Go Giants, Warriors, and 49ers!). I enjoy traveling in California, the US + international destinations, wine tasting, reading, volunteering, photography, and spending time with family. Big fitness enthusiast (running, hiking, pickleball, skiing).

name: Scott Butterworth
title: Senior Studio Communications Manager
bio:
Senior public relations manager and former journalist with more than 18 years experience in games, tech, and entertainment. Accomplished strategist, storyteller, and copywriter with proven expertise in planning, coordinating, and executing integrated communications campaigns for best-selling consumer software. 

Most recently served as Senior Studio Communications Manager at EA, working alongside the leadership teams of multiple development studios to provide strategic counsel, develop short- and long-term comms initiatives, facilitate organizational changes, build owned external content, and more.
 
Before joining EA, served as North and South American PR lead for 2K Games, developing and overseeing integrated communications strategies for all of 2K's core titles. Previously led global PR strategy for multiple best-selling titles, including Borderlands 3 (post-launch), Tiny Tina's Wonderlands, and Mafia: Trilogy.

A writer at heart with a nose for news and trends, as well as a deep understanding of audience expectations. Member of the planning committee for 2K's mental health employee resource group. Longtime volunteer at 826 Valencia writing and tutoring center. Committed to and passionate about diversity, equity, and inclusion.

bio: I started in commercial real estate in Austin in 2013, at 23 years old. Thirteen years later I'm still here, working land, retail, and industrial deals across Texas, leading a team at Life by Design Commercial, and teaching new commercial agents the business I've built my career in. I'm a generalist by choice. Investment sales, owner user sales, tenant rep, landlord rep. The clients I work with range from first time investors to seasoned developers, and the deals range from a small parcel in Manor to multi tenant retail and industrial business parks in the suburbs. What I care about is doing the work well. Reading the market honestly, telling clients what I actually think, and building relationships that outlast any one transaction. Most of my business comes from referrals and repeat clients, and I'd like to keep it that way. I'm a Native Austinite. I know the corridors, the submarkets, the operators, and the rhythm of this city because I grew up watching it become what it is. That perspective shows up in every deal I work. When I'm not selling real estate I'm on a golf course, at the gym, or with my wife Micheall and our dogs. Life by Design isn't just our team name. It's how we try to actually live. If you have a commercial real estate project in Texas, send me a message. Always happy to help.

bio: Ruth Wang is a distinguished real estate professional known for her strategic thinking, skilled negotiations, and dedication to excellence and innovation. With a career spanning corporate, commercial, and luxury residential real estate, she has built a strong reputation for delivering outstanding results for her clients. Ruth began her real estate career in 2007 as a Corporate and Commercial Real Estate Broker at Jones Lang LaSalle (JLL). In 2017, she transitioned into luxury residential markets, leveraging her deep knowledge of the NYC metro real estate landscape, extensive business network, and strong financial expertise. She has since closed record-setting waterfront transactions in Jersey City and facilitated bulk sales for corporate and high-net-worth investors. Embracing the future of real estate, Ruth joined eXp Realty, a cloud-based, publicly traded brokerage, to expand her and her team’s footprint on a local, regional, and global scale. Powered by eXp’s innovative, tech-driven platform, she delivers seamless, cutting-edge service that elevates the client experience. Known for her efficiency, Ruth consistently closes both listings and purchase transactions within just two months—because in her world, results don’t wait. Beyond real estate, Ruth has established herself in finance and business strategy. She previously worked as a Senior Financial Analyst on Wall Street and served as a Business Advisor specializing in strategic planning. She served as Vice President of AREAA Central New Jersey and remains actively engaged in executive-level professional and Chinese-American organizations. Ruth holds a Master’s degree in Financial Management from Pace University, strategically located in the financial hub of Wall Street, New York City. She has called the NYC metro area home since 1996. bio: I am a passionate influencer marketing expert and have a proven track record of creating successful campaigns that drive engagement, increase brand awareness, and ultimately, boost revenue. I've been in the industry for 5 years and I've learned a lot about what works (and what doesn't!) when it comes to building a strong influencer and ambassador channel. My approach to influencer marketing is all about building strong, authentic relationships with influencers and creating content that feels genuine and engaging. I have a strong knack for identifying the right influencers for a campaign. title: Marketing Strategies,Digital Marketing, Social Media Strategies,Events Planning and Business Development
bio:
I am a marketing professional turned fitness entrepreneur, studio owner, and personal trainer—combining strategy, wellness, and personal branding to help people grow stronger bodies and sustainable businesses.

I am the Founder and Head Trainer of Empowr Fit Studio, where I provide:
 • One-on-one personal training
 • Pilates instruction
 • Group fitness classes
 • Strength and functional training

My background is in marketing and network marketing, where I spent years building brands, supporting teams, and understanding what truly drives growth, connection, and duplication. Today, I apply that same marketing mindset to fitness, wellness, and business-building.

In addition to running my studio, I am a Network Marketing Ambassador, building and scaling my business from home—proving that with the right systems, discipline, and branding, it is possible to create impact and income on your own terms.

What defines my work:
 • Strategic thinking
 • Consistency over hype
 • Education, not shortcuts
 • Personal brand over trends

I believe fitness is not just physical—it’s a leadership skill.
And marketing, when done right, is service.

📩 Open to collaborations, partnerships, and growth-driven conversations.

title: Marketing Director, Australia at Peloton | ex Tough Mudder, Lonely Planet, Contiki Holidays
bio:
I’ve spent the last 15+ years in global strategic marketing roles, leading high performing marketing teams, driving growth and kicking goals for some of the most disruptive and category-defining consumer brands across the globe, including Peloton, Tough Mudder, Lonely Planet and Contiki Holidays. 

My passion for marketing is driven by my innate curiosity of human behavior, creative ingenuity and analytical problem-solving. I believe true marketers are commercially savvy, embrace technology and look outside the box to build real connections with customers. They seek the intersection of powerful storytelling, data-driven insights, and results-driven marketing initiatives to drive sustainable growth and measurable results. 

CORE COMPETENCIES: 🚀
Brand Management | Growth Marketing | Strategic Planning | 360 Media Strategy | Data Analysis | Performance | Digital Marketing and E-commerce | PR & Communications | Product Marketing | Content | Social Media & Influencer Strategy | Team Management & Leadership | Agency Management | Forecasting and Budget Management

PROFESSIONAL AWARDS: 🏆
· The Drum Marketing Awards, Best Brand Experiences / Event Strategy of the Year (Tough Mudder in partnership with Samsung - "Tough Mudder 360".)
· Ad Week, Best Campaign (Tough Mudder - "It's all been training")
· Webby Awards, General Sites & Apps Award (Lonely Planet - Guides Mobile App.)
· SMITTY Award, Most Innovative Social Media App or Technology (Contiki - Contiki Shout Mobile App.)
· The International ECHO Awards, Silver Award (Contiki #NoRegrets Brand Campaign)

bio: As the Global Partnerships Director at Gymshark, the UK's fastest-growing company, I am responsible for growing and developing the Gymshark brand across the globe through innovative and engaging influencer, athlete, and entertainment marketing and brand partnerships. I have over eight years of experience in this field, and I am passionate about connecting with consumers in new ways as their wants, needs, and touchpoints evolve. I have built and championed a culture within Gymshark that combines best-in-class influencer marketing and flawless athlete experience, which has proven to be a huge success factor for Gymshark. I have also been recognised as one of the top 50 influencers in the industry by Talking Influence, for my thought leadership, innovation, and creativity. My mission is to inspire and empower millions of people to achieve their fitness and lifestyle goals through the power of social media and authentic brand storytelling.

bio: I am a graduate of the University of Southern California with a degree in International Relations Global Business, focusing on Global Marketing. Over the past few years, I’ve combined my marketing expertise with my passion for wellness to grow my personal brand and build an impactful online presence. Drawing on my professional experience in social media strategy, branding, and creative direction, I've led campaigns boosting engagement by over 35% and managed influencer relations for top wellness brands. Since launching my own nutrition and fitness business in 2023, I’ve become a Nike Trainer, coached clients in holistic health, spoke at events, schools, and webinars, sharing insights on mindfulness and sustainable wellness habits. I'm currently pursing my Master of Science in Human Nutrition at the University of Bridgeport, working on my online fitness and health virtual community platform and seeking opportunities where I can merge my love for health and fitness with creative marketing conversations and inspiring team collaboration. I thrive in roles where creativity meets strategy and where I can connect with others to share knowledge and make a difference in the health and wellness industry. I’m passionate about working on projects that align with my mission to help others live a healthy mindful and authentic life. Let’s connect! I’d love to explore how I can bring value to your team!

bio: I am a dynamic marketing and communications leader with a passion for building brands, telling compelling stories, and fostering meaningful community engagement. With a career that bridges the worlds of fitness, events, and women's sports leadership, I bring both strategic insight and hands-on experience to every campaign I touch. 🔹 What drives me: Creating marketing that connects. I specialize in developing and executing multi-channel strategies that not only drive awareness and growth but also inspire real-world action—from lead generation and content strategy to social media, email, and community engagement. 🔹 Where I lead: As Marketing Manager for Spartan DEKA, I lead initiatives that grow brand visibility and support affiliate gym partners across the globe. Whether it’s launching a national campaign or fine-tuning daily content, I know how to balance big-picture goals and strategies with tactical execution. I also serve as VP of Communications for WISE San Diego, where I oversee cross-platform messaging to engage members and amplify our mission to empower women in the business of sports. 🔹 What I bring: Proven marketing results—from driving digital engagement and customer retention to boosting membership and event turnout. Brand storytelling—crafting authentic narratives that resonate across audiences and platforms Community leadership—connecting people through shared purpose, whether online or on the competition arena 🔹 Why it matters: My career began on the gym floor, not in a boardroom—which means I’ve lived the customer journey and bring that empathy into every marketing decision. I lead with the mission first and always, and blend creativity with clarity, strategy with storytelling, and hustle with heart.

title: Studio Founder | Creative Partner to Agencies & Filmmakers | Championing Smarter, Sustainable Production across the Midlands
bio: I’m Mat Cooper, Founder and Director of Spaghetti Studios, a leading independent production facility in Birmingham, UK Over the past 20years I’ve helped shape how creative content is made in the Midlands: from commercials and broadcast productions to livestreams and large-scale corporate shoots. My background in Production, Engineering and Technical direction means I bridge the gap between creative ambition and practical delivery ensuring that every production runs smoothly, looks exceptional, and achieves its purpose. Spaghetti Studios was built following the London Olympics to give agencies, broadcasters, and brands a home for production in the heart of the UK; a space where creativity, technology, and reliability meet. Under my direction we’ve developed three purpose-built stages, a full in-house crew network, and a reputation for calm, precision-led delivery. Beyond daily production, I’m passionate about strengthening the region’s film and media infrastructure. I regularly advise agencies, producers and education partners on marketing/communications, studio operations, skills development, and sustainable production practices. I believe our industry thrives when technical expertise and creative trust go hand in hand — and I’m committed to helping that happen, project by project and policy by policy. 🎥 Studio Hire • 💡 Lighting & Technical Direction • 👥 Crew & Production Partnerships • 🌍 Regional Media Development • 📍 Birmingham

title: Freelance Art Director // Model Maker // Prop Modeller for commercials, TV & Film.
bio: EMMA-ROSE DADE, IS A UK BASED FREELANCE ART DIRECTOR AND MODEL MAKER WITH OVER A DECADE OF EXPERIENCE WORKING ON A VARIETY OF PROJECTS. Her background in animation, fine art and photography has given her a passion for working with tactile materials to realise designs and bring them to life. Emma likes to work for ambitious directors & designers with a distinct style, and enjoys the challenge of realising their vision. She has experience Art Directing miniature stop motion and live action commercials, pilots, proof of concepts, music videos and short films. Managing builds, crews, schedule and budgets from small prop projects to multiple set builds. She has made miniature sets and props for TV series, TV commercials, TV idents, pilots, Music videos, proof of concepts, pitches, promos, editorials, social content, explainer videos and shop installations using many different techniques and materials. Emma is driven by the desire to continue learning new techniques and experimenting with new materials, putting them to use in new and exciting ways on interesting projects.

Our clients range from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies such as Bureau Veritas, GuoTai Junan or Savills. On average, our clients increase their sales by 10 to 30% within the first 3 months of our collaboration. I have always been passionate about public speaking (500 speeches and trainings in the last 5 years thanks to Toastmasters). What differentiates me is that people find my keynotes and trainings extremely explosive, practical and inspiring. I am regularly encouraged and challenged by some of the greatest coaches and mentors in the world including Tony Robins, David Allen, Jack Daly, and many more. Following my passion to be able to empower more people, I am also contributing to the community by being an expert in residence at Chinaccelerator and teaching Master and MBA students at Jiao Tong, em lyon and CEIBS by hoping to participate in creating the next best leaders! You are welcome to contact me if you are interested in having me for a speech, a meeting to scale your sales team or joining our company to bring positive impacts to yourself and others.

I led the Web3 NFT project Trekki for Trip.com, collaborating with AWS to deliver a full-stack solution from smart contract design to cloud deployment. This project combined travel privileges with NFTs, expanding Trip.com’s global influence in the Web3 ecosystem. Additionally, I spearheaded international flight repricing optimization and NDC channel integration, significantly improving system flexibility and customer experience. Beyond my core work, I am passionate about hackathons — finalist in the Google Developer Hackathon and award winner in Trip.com Hackathon. I believe continuous learning and rapid iteration are the keys to innovation. Let’s connect if you’re interested in travel tech, distributed systems, Web3, or AI innovation.

bio: With 20+ years’ experience in China commercial real estate covering consultancy, leasing, investment, asset and property management, I have often been considered as the expert in the real estate market. I was the industry’s first female MD for the region when i became Managing Director of Colliers International for the East China region in 2004,. I played a vital role in growing Colliers from a small 20-person team relying on overseas referrals to a hugely successful office. Under my leadership, our office won “Office of the Year’ for 3 consecutive years, and became one of the biggest real estate agencies in China. I also built the whole capital market and investment sales business as the China MD for this product line. Many investment transactions I personally concluded in the past became the industry benchmarks, including the en bloc sales of Platinum, which was the first-ever and largest transaction in Shanghai by a foreign institutional fund. It was also the only prime office building in China to have been transacted three times by the same agency within a five-year period. As one of the authoritative voices in the industry, I speak regularly at industry conferences and on major media.

name: Edison Tamascia
title: Presidente na Febrafar & Farmarcas
bio:
Trabalhando para estar presente na foto do futuro.

Empresário do setor farmacêutico, com 50 anos de atuação no segmento, palestrante
e um dos principais embaixadores do associativismo do país.

Líder visionário no setor farmacêutico brasileiro, reconhecido por sua contribuição revolucionária ao associativismo. Nascido em Paranuapuã, no interior de São Paulo, ele construiu uma trajetória marcada por inovação e perseverança, fundando a Febrafar (Federação Brasileira das Redes Associativistas de Farmácias) e a administradora de redes associativa de farmácias Farmarcas.

Sob sua liderança, a Febrafar reúne mais de 17.000 farmácias e 69 redes associativas, transformando o cenário do varejo farmacêutico com um crescimento anual superior à média do mercado. Além disso, a Farmarcas, que administra 1.600 farmácias em 11 redes, consolidou-se como o quarto maior grupo de farmácias em faturamento no Brasil.

Tamascia acredita na força da união e na digitalização como pilares para a modernização e competitividade das farmácias independentes, permitindo que pequenas farmácias compitam de igual para igual com grandes redes. Sua visão inovadora continua a moldar o futuro do varejo farmacêutico no Brasil.

COO for Latin America at Baker Tilly International (global British network). Businss background and trained in the school of life and the real world of business, as well as at the Big Four (Deloitte and Ernst & Young). Co-author of the book "Turnaround 100 Segredos". bio: ➡️ My journey began in a small wooden house on a farm in Plaucheville, Louisiana, where big dreams took root among five siblings and humble beginnings. What started as a necessity of joining the military to secure an education transformed into a passionate career in technology that has spanned over 15 years. Technology has always been my playground. I'm that person who sees a complex system and immediately starts thinking about how to optimize and improve. From my early days in IT networking to becoming a strategic technology leader, I've been driven by an insatiable desire to solve problems and create meaningful solutions. My professional path is defined by translating complex technological challenges into strategic business outcomes. I've led transformative projects for large enterprises, managing intricate technology initiatives that reshape organizational infrastructures. Whether guiding IT transformations during mergers or migrating data centers, I bring a unique blend of technical expertise and strategic vision. Leadership, for me, isn't about titles, it's about empowerment. I've been fortunate to work with remarkable mentors who saw potential in me and challenged me to grow. Mark Northrup taught me technical decision-making, Mark Madsen refined my strategic thinking, and Brian Kirkpatrick helped me master people management. My approach is rooted in a genuine passion for people and technology. I thrive on building high-performing teams, driving innovation, and creating environments where potential transforms into exceptional performance. My analytical mind allows me to bridge gaps and deliver results that matter. What truly sets me apart is my commitment to continuous growth and my ability to see beyond immediate technical challenges. My background in military service instilled discipline, my technical training provided expertise, and my leadership experience has refined my ability to inspire and execute. When I'm not strategizing technology solutions, I'm a pilot, musician, and craftsman, pursuits that reflect my problem-solving nature and love for understanding how things work. My professional mission is straightforward: deliver exceptional services that drive operational excellence and create tangible business growth. I combine technical acumen, strategic leadership, and a customer-centric mindset to transform challenges into opportunities. Whether leading complex IT transformations or guiding teams through intricate technological landscapes, I'm committed to making a meaningful impact.

bio: I am a seasoned professional with demonstrated leadership skills and my unique background includes both creative and technical roles. From my early days in advertising to my latest adventures in engineering and management, my attitude has always been, “I can learn that,” and I’ve yet to be wrong about it. Going way back to pre-professional days, I’ve had experience in surface mining and power plant boiler maintenance as both a dynamiter and heavy equipment operator. I’ve served an internship in the office of a U.S. Congressman and was fortunate enough to have stood in the Oval Office with President Ronald Reagan and Susan Butcher of Iditarod fame. More recently, I’ve stepped outside my comfort zone and served on the Board of Directors at a commercial bank in southeast Missouri. Even further afield, in January of 2014, I took a “night job” at the helm of the Ford-Lincoln dealership in my hometown, and I have been actively engaged in the agriculture industry, working our family farms in the great state of Missouri. My life has been a strange ride with many a twist and turn, and I’m always interested to see what's coming around the bend. <><

name: Mateus De Campos Oliveira
title: Architect | Landscape Designer | Interiors | Commercial | Residential | Co-founder of Vento Arquitetura
bio: I'm an architect and urban planner graduated from the Faculty of Architecture and Urbanism at the University of São Paulo (FAU-USP) in 2018, with a specialization in landscape architecture projects. I co-founded Vento Arquitetura, where I lead the creative department, developing concepts and aesthetic-functional solutions, as well as overseeing the firm's recent expansion to Europe. Vento was founded in 2021 in partnership with architect and lighting designer Gabriela Correia de Araujo. Our office is located in São José dos Campos, São Paulo, and since 2024, we have also been operating in Europe following my move to Porto (Portugal), where I’m pursuing a master’s degree in Landscape Architecture at the University of Porto. We have developed over 100 projects, including residential, commercial, and corporate spaces, for clients such as Oakberry, Ball Corporation, SEBRAE, Coco Leve, MyIdols, Invita Medical, Lovis Sunglasses, Estilus Ótica, and Explicando Consórcio. Our experience with commercial and corporate projects gives us a few advantages: we work with agility, are committed to deadlines, and maintain close contact with our clients — following each step, from concept to construction, with a focus on delivering excellent results. In parallel, I’m also the founder of Estúdio Relevo, a studio focused on landscape architecture projects. I love cooking, traveling, and never turn down an invitation to go to the beach! Follow us on Instagram and swing by our website to see more! https://www.instagram.com/vento_arquitetura/ https://www.ventoarquitetura.arq.br/

Notre agence réalise des projets résidentiels tels que la rénovation de maisons et d’appartements mais également des projets pour le compte de professionnels en réaménageant des espaces de bureaux, restaurants et hôtels. Nous nous distinguons par notre exigence et notre volonté d’imaginer des lieux respectant les différents modes de vie. Notre objectif est d'accompagner nos clients dans toutes les étapes de leur projet, tant au Portugal qu’à l’étranger, en nous entourant d'artisanats, entrepreneurs et fournisseurs qui partagent notre vision et nos valeurs.

name: Flávia Tavernari
title: Architect | Designer | Project Manager | Career Mentor | Certified Trainer | Co-Founder of LUFT Arquitectos, O Sabático and Clube de Decoração
bio: am an Architect, Designer, and Project Manager with solid international experience — particularly in Portugal, Brazil, and Ireland — combining technical expertise and strategic vision across all stages of architectural and interior projects: from concept and development to permitting, multidisciplinary coordination, and construction supervision, ensuring quality, compliance, and on-time delivery. My career includes leading large teams and managing projects of different scales and typologies, always balancing design, functionality, and feasibility. I am the Co-founder of LUFT Arquitetos, a practice specialized in building permitting, architectural projects, construction supervision, and project and site management. We work with technical rigor, close client collaboration, and solutions that integrate innovation, sustainability, and regulatory compliance. I am also the Co-founder of Clube de Decoração, a school dedicated to practical training in Interior Design and Home Staging, where I teach certified courses that connect creativity, strategy, and professional application. Previously, as Co-founder of O Sabático Consulting, I was responsible for defining governance, business planning, policies, and operational processes, establishing the company’s philosophy and culture with a long-term vision and focus on sustainable growth. I continue to contribute strategically to its business development and projects. I am certified by the Project Management Institute (PMI) as a PMP® – Project Management Professional, with postgraduate studies and specializations in Brazil, Portugal, the UK, Ireland, the USA, and Mexico. I am completing my Master’s degree in Project Management at the Escuela de Negocios Europea de Barcelona (ENEB). A passionate traveler, I have visited more than 80 countries, seeking new experiences and developing a unique perspective on societies and local cultures — bringing global references and inspiration into every project I design.

Originally from Lisbon and based in the Algarve since 2018, I’ve been managing and delivering complex interior design projects that combine creative vision with operational efficiency. Driven by the ambition to shape a new standard of design excellence in the region, I co-founded Vanderbuilt Design Group — a studio focused on delivering comprehensive, high-level interior solutions for private clients and property developers across the Algarve’s Golden Triangle. As a business owner, I’m involved in every stage of the process — from client relationships and design development to project coordination and team management. With a background in interior design, client service and large-scale execution, I bring clarity, consistency and purpose to each project. At Vanderbuilt, we believe that refined interiors are built on strong concepts, collaborative partnerships and attention to every detail — from layout to final styling.

name: Gabriela De Oliveira
title: Gestão Estratégica e Desenvolvimento de Negócios de Varejo, Operações, Retail, Travel Retail, Luxury
company: General Shopping e Outlets do Brasil S/A
bio:
Mais de 20 anos de experiência de varejo em empresas nacional e multinacional nas áreas de Operações e Comercial, ocupando posições de liderança e planejamento estratégico. 

Minhas principais qualificações:

- Desenvolvimento e Gestão de negócio nos segmentos de Varejo, Travel Retail e Publicidade e Propaganda através de times de alta performance e equipes multidisciplinares. 
- Gestão Comercial:  Desenvolvimento e implementação de estratégias de vendas. Gestão de equipes de vendas e atingimento de metas.
- Planejamento Estratégico: Definição de objetivos e metas de longo prazo. Análise de mercado e benchmarking. 
- Gestão de Operações de Varejo: Otimização de processos operacionais. Implementação de melhores práticas no ponto de venda (PDV). 
- Gestão Financeira: Análise e controle de P&L. Planejamento de orçamento e controle de custos
- Análise de KPIs e Performance: Monitoramento de indicadores-chave de desempenho (KPIs). Análise de dados para tomada de decisões estratégicas
- Customer Experience (CX): Desenvolvimento de estratégias para melhorar a experiência do cliente. Implementação de iniciativas de atendimento ao cliente.
- Gestão de Equipes: Desenvolvimento e liderança de equipes de alta performance. Habilidade em coaching e mentoria. 
- Marketing e Merchandising: Planejamento e execução de campanhas de marketing. Gestão de visual merchandising e apresentação de produtos. 
- Gestão de Supply Chain e Logística: Planejamento de demanda e gestão de inventário.  
- Transformação Digital e E-commerce: Integração de canais online e offline. Implementação de ferramentas digitais e tecnologias emergentes.  
- CRM e Fidelização de Clientes: Gestão de programas de fidelidade e retenção de clientes. Análise de dados de CRM para segmentação e personalização de ofertas.  
- Negociação e Gestão de Relacionamentos: Habilidade em negociações com fornecedores e parceiros. Construção e manutenção de relacionamentos estratégicos.  
- Inovação e Gestão da Mudança: Implementação de inovações em processos. Gestão de mudanças organizacionais e culturais.
- Conselheira do Instituto C&A, responsável pela coordenação do grupo de Voluntários, multiplicadora da causa, bem como, participação ativa nos projetos desenvolvidos nas regiões de atuação.
 

Contatos: freitasgoliveira@gmail.com

name: Juliane Quaresma
title: Gerente na Lojas Renner
bio: Como profissional, minha trajetória é marcada por uma vasta experiência tanto no varejo físico quanto online, sobretudo nas áreas de operações, produto e comercial, em empresas de grande porte. Desenvolvi habilidades sólidas em diversas frentes, desde o desenvolvimento de produtos até a gestão comercial, liderança de categorias e marcas, parcerias estratégicas, alcance de metas, gestão de fornecedores locais e internacionais, até a implementação de estratégias nos pontos de venda. Ao longo da minha jornada, pude comprovar minha capacidade em gerir equipes multidisciplinares, conceber e executar estratégias operacionais e comerciais, negociar, desenvolver estratégias de vendas, analisar riscos, avaliar a viabilidade de marcas, monitorar sell out e acompanhar KPIs. Minha formação acadêmica inclui uma graduação em Jornalismo, Comunicação Organizacional e Negócios, além de um MBA em Gestão Comercial. Entre as características que me destacam, estão a responsabilidade, a comunicação eficaz, a dedicação, a visão analítica, o bom relacionamento interpessoal, a organização, o senso crítico, o planejamento e a resiliência. No dia a dia, minha rotina envolve a gestão de pessoas, o trabalho em equipe, o foco em resultados, a busca pela inovação, a tomada de decisão e a gestão eficaz do tempo. Além disso, possuo expertise no Pacote Office e Google Analytics, e conhecimento em plataformas como Vtex e Salesforce, que complementam minha capacidade de atuação.
